scenario: A museum curator is arranging exactly six sculptures — Forsythe, Giordano, Huang, Ivanov, Juarez, and Kline — along a single corridor with six consecutive display pedestals numbered 1 through 6 from the entrance. Each sculpture occupies exactly one pedestal, and each pedestal holds exactly one sculpture. Pedestals 1, 2, and 3 lie in the museum's North wing; pedestals 4, 5, and 6 lie in the South wing. The arrangement must meet the following conditions: Forsythe is displayed in the North wing. Giordano is displayed on a pedestal numbered higher than Huang's. Ivanov is displayed on pedestal 5. Juarez and Kline are displayed in the same wing. Huang is displayed on a pedestal immediately next to Forsythe's.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be a complete and accurate assignment of the sculptures to pedestals 1 through 6, respectively?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Forsythe, Huang, Giordano, Juarez, Ivanov, Kline

choices.label: B
choices.text: Huang, Forsythe, Giordano, Juarez, Kline, Ivanov

choices.label: C
choices.text: Forsythe, Giordano, Huang, Juarez, Ivanov, Kline

choices.label: D
choices.text: Juarez, Forsythe, Huang, Giordano, Ivanov, Kline

choices.label: E
choices.text: Forsythe, Huang, Kline, Juarez, Giordano, Ivanov

explanations.correct: Forsythe is on 1 (North); Huang on 2 is adjacent to Forsythe; Giordano on 3 is after Huang; Ivanov on 5; Juarez on 4 and Kline on 6 are both in the South wing. Every rule is satisfied.
explanations.B: Ivanov must be on pedestal 5, not pedestal 6.
explanations.C: Giordano (pedestal 2) is before Huang (pedestal 3), violating the rule that Giordano is after Huang.
explanations.D: Forsythe is on pedestal 2 but Huang is on pedestal 3 — that's fine for adjacency, but Giordano on 4 is after Huang on 3, which is fine. However, Juarez is on pedestal 1 (North) and Kline is on pedestal 6 (South), so they are in different wings, violating the same-wing rule.
explanations.E: Giordano is on pedestal 5, but Ivanov must be on pedestal 5.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: B
choices.text: Giordano is displayed in the South wing.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Huang is displayed in the North wing.

choices.label: E
choices.text: Kline is displayed in the South wing.

explanations.correct: Forsythe must be in the North wing (pedestals 1–3), and Huang must be adjacent to Forsythe. Since Huang must also be before Giordano (so Huang can't be pedestal 6) and must be adjacent to Forsythe who is in 1, 2, or 3, Huang lands on pedestal 1, 2, or 3 — all North wing.
explanations.A: Forsythe could be on pedestal 2 or 3 instead (e.g., Forsythe on 2, Huang on 1).
explanations.B: Giordano could be on pedestal 3 (North wing), as long as Huang is on 1 or 2.
explanations.D: Juarez could be on any pedestal in whichever wing matches Kline's; many solutions place Juarez elsewhere.
explanations.E: Kline could be in the North wing (e.g., Kline on 1 with Juarez on 3).

questions.questionStem: If Forsythe is displayed on pedestal 1, which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: With Forsythe on 1, Huang must be on 2 (adjacency). Giordano, Juarez, and Kline fill 3, 4, and 6. One valid arrangement: Forsythe 1, Huang 2, Giordano 3, Juarez 4, Ivanov 5, Kline 6 — Juarez on 4 works.
explanations.A: Huang must be adjacent to Forsythe (pedestal 1), forcing Huang onto pedestal 2, not 3.
explanations.B: Huang occupies pedestal 2 (adjacency to Forsythe on 1), so Giordano cannot be there.
explanations.C: Huang occupies pedestal 2, so Kline cannot be there.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

explanations.correct: Huang must come before Giordano (lower-numbered pedestal), so Huang cannot occupy pedestal 6 — there would be no pedestal left for Giordano at a higher number.
explanations.A: Possible: Forsythe on 2, Huang on 1, Giordano later.
explanations.D: Possible: Forsythe 3, Huang 2, Kline 1, Juarez 4 or 6.
explanations.E: Possible: Forsythe 1, Huang 2, Kline 3, Juarez 6 — wait, Juarez and Kline must share wing, so Juarez on 6 (South) with Kline on 4 (South) works, e.g., Forsythe 2, Huang 1, Kline 4, Juarez 6.

questions.questionStem: If Huang is displayed on pedestal 1, then which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Juarez is displayed in the North wing.

explanations.correct: With Huang on pedestal 1, Forsythe must be adjacent to Huang, placing Forsythe on pedestal 2 (the only adjacent pedestal). Forsythe also must be in the North wing, which pedestal 2 satisfies.
explanations.A: Giordano could be on pedestal 3, 4, or 6 — not fixed.
explanations.C: Juarez and Kline share a wing, but they could both be in the South wing (e.g., Juarez 4, Kline 6).
explanations.D: Kline could be on pedestal 3, 4, or 6 depending on Juarez's placement.
